lines: Anyone who did not visit the library that week --- weekend-only or online-only card holders.
Same desk, same visitors, more of them: four weeks of the same procedure still reaches only
the people who come in and bother to write, so the lean is the same --- about 80\%, not 45\%.
Nonresponse: the 42 who never picked up may use the library differently from the 78 who
did, so the answering group leans. Fix: keep calling back until every one of the 120 answers.
